item.text: I’ll make the smallest possible change: adjust the loop bound in `calcTotal` so it stops before `items.length`. No other behavior will be touched.

I couldn’t apply the fix because the workspace is currently read-only and approvals are disabled.

The required one-line fix is:

```diff
-  for (let i = 0; i <= items.length; i++) {
+  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
```

That prevents `calcTotal` from reading past the end of `items` and crashing on `items[i].price`.
